messages:
Linh: FYI candidate Priet is confirmed onsite Thu 10:30am but asked about visa expense reimbursement and parking. cc @Maya @TravelOps @Security
Maya: We reimburse visa fees with receipt and a short note; need pre-approval for >$250. I'll start approval thread. For parking we can prepay a Lot C pass. Any dietary needs?
Linh: Priet is vegetarian and prefers nut-free. Also needs a visitor badge printed in advance; arriving on Amtrak.
TravelOps: We can prepay parking and provide a taxi voucher if arrival is late. Send passport name for visa receipt matching.
Security: We'll preprint a one-day badge. Please add "escort to 3F" in reception notes. ID pickup requires signing NDA; bring a printed copy.
Facilities: Lunch order noted: vegetarian, nut-free. We'll put a label on the catering box. Meeting Room 3-2 reserved 10:00-1:00.
Maya: Approval for visa reimbursement set to finance; please DM receipt after candidate submits. Door code for hosts: `88*22` (host-only).
Linh: Sent passport name and arrival ETA to Maya. I'll confirm parking pass number on the invite and DM candidate pickup instructions.
Maya: Done 12
 invite updated, badge queued, parking prepaid, and catering order placed. Closing loop.
